Hereditary nerve-tumor syndrome with characteristic skin involvement in the predominant NF1 form; hearing loss is subtype-specific.

Mitochondrial metabolic dysfunction directly affects skeletal muscle and nervous system; additional organs vary across subtypes.
Inherited shortening of metacarpals/metatarsals and other skeletal abnormalities; impacted teeth have unspecified frequency.

Malignant glioma originating in midline structures of the central nervous system.
Inherited high myopia; associated retinal holes and cataracts remain within the ocular axis.
Familial disorder producing varioliform cutaneous atrophic scars; macular atrophy here describes skin lesions, not retinal disease.
